# Talk2Forms

> Talk2Forms is a free, AI-powered browser extension and website that fills out
> any online form by voice, in any language. Users create a profile once, then
> use the Chrome extension to scan any form on any website — the AI reads the
> form, matches it against the user's saved profile, and asks about anything
> missing through a spoken voice interview. Built for speed and accessibility,
> for anyone who finds typing slow, tiring, or difficult.

## Key facts
- Free to use. Users bring their own free Google Gemini API key.
- Works on any form: job applications, signups, surveys, checkout forms.
- Supports 99+ languages, auto-detected from speech.
- Available as a Chrome browser extension.
- Built with privacy in mind: never fills fields belonging to someone else
  (e.g. "recipient" or "emergency contact" fields), never touches password fields.

## Pages
- Homepage: https://talk2forms.site/
- Privacy policy: https://talk2forms.site/privacy
- How to get a free Gemini API key: https://talk2forms.site/gemini-key-guide
